card.name: Linking verbs after a drug name
card.fires_on: Small linking words (is, be, its, and) right after a drug name as the sentence subject, usually in nursing-mother, renal-impairment or washout passages. The next words are likely to say how the drug is excreted or present in milk.

modes.label: is/be after drug
modes.description: The verb follows a drug name in lactation or renal sections, before a statement about excretion or presence in milk.
modes.example: Nursing Mothers As has been found to occur with many other drugs, citalopram<< is>> excreted in human breast milk

modes.label: its/and after fluoxetine
modes.description: A linking word follows fluoxetine in a sentence about long half-life of the drug and its metabolites.
